title: lantana camara subsp. moldenkei
intro: Lantana camara subsp. moldenkei, commonly known as small-leaf lantana, is a subspecies of the Lantana camara plant, a shrub native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of small-leaf lantana include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various infections, making it a valuable remedy in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are present in the plant's leaves, flowers, and stems.
